title: Retinal foundation-model biomarker RetiME maps retinal photographs to mortality risk
summary: A deep-learning biomarker built on large foundation models, Retinal Mortality Equivalent (RetiME), maps retinal photographs to individual mortality risk. Trained on a European cohort and externally validated in three cohorts from Southeast Asia, Eurasia and North America, it was associated with all-cause and cause-specific mortality and incident disease, produced lifespan trajectories that clustered into mortality patterns, and genome-wide analyses found associated loci.
ai_technology: Deep-learning retinal biomarker (RetiME) built on large foundation models

evidence.tested: External validation in three independent cohorts for associations with mortality and incident disease.
